objective: V3.9.12 — Portable Context Terminal: make any AI/model surface usable as a manual Crowley terminal with Crowley context in and structured writeback out.
context: After V3.9.9–V3.9.11, Crowley has stronger context quality, task framing, and live activity. The direction pivot is that Crowley is not a single AI model or just a UI; it is the persistent context layer that follows D across reasoning surfaces. V3.9.12 proves the manual terminal loop before V4 memory lanes, with ChatGPT as the first tested surface.
decisions: Keep existing board order: V3.9.9 #62/#63, then V3.9.10 #64-#69, then V3.9.11 #70-#75, then V3.9.12
V3.9.12 is local/manual only: no browser extension, OAuth, cloud sync, or live terminal automation
Export a medium Crowley packet, not a raw database dump
Writeback stores an episodic session receipt separately from candidate sparks
Raw transcripts are not saved by default
Persist or preserve writeback metadata instead of dropping /api/ingest metadata
V4.0 handles durable memory lanes; V3.9.12 only proves packet-in/writeback-out
non_goals: Auto-promoting sensitive personal memory to canon
risks: Packet can become too large and make the active model overfit the packet instead of helping
Writeback can become noisy if sparks lack why_keep
Sensitive lanes must not become high-trust memory without review
Ingest metadata preservation must not break existing /api/ingest callers
qa_expectations: CROWLEY_TEST_MODE=1 CROWLEY_EMBED_PROVIDER=off full unittest; focused tests for packet shape, writeback parsing, candidate spark ingest, metadata preservation, and do-not-save transcript behavior.
next_action: Codex mints with scripts/codex_sync.py --create-tickets tickets/v3.9.12_portable_context_terminal.json. Cursor should not claim until V3.9.11 #75 doc lock closes.

approval.note: Approved and minted 2026-07-02 as tickets #76-#80 after model-agnostic naming correction. Cursor should not claim until V3.9.11 closes.

tickets.title: V3.9.12 Portable Terminal: context packet exporter
tickets.description: Build a local export path that generates a paste-ready medium Crowley packet for any AI/model surface from existing context/sync sources. Include Crowley identity, D operating context, current world, active work, constraints, recent decisions, selected relevant memories, and writeback instructions. ChatGPT is the first manual target, not the architectural boundary. Keep output compact and human-readable.
acceptance: Exporter produces a paste-ready packet without raw DB dumps
Packet includes Crowley identity and the persistent-context-layer framing
Packet includes current work, constraints, recent decisions, and selected memories
Packet includes explicit writeback contract and soft context-pull guidance
Focused tests cover packet shape and size discipline

tickets.title: V3.9.12 Portable Terminal: writeback schema and parser
tickets.description: Define and parse structured terminal session writeback containing session, surface, model/provider if known, sparks, decisions, lessons, open_loops, corrections, context_pull_candidates, and do_not_save. Spark entries require content, lane, why_keep, confidence, and sensitivity. Parser should return clear validation errors without mutating memory on invalid input.
acceptance: Parser accepts valid structured writeback
Parser rejects sparks missing content, lane, why_keep, confidence, or sensitivity
Accepted lanes include learning, work, relationships, money, health, operating_style
do_not_save is parsed but never persisted as memory content
Tests cover valid and invalid writeback payloads

tickets.title: V3.9.12 Portable Terminal: ingest candidate sparks
tickets.description: Save terminal writeback into existing memory infrastructure. Store the session recap as an episodic receipt and structured sparks as candidate memory items where possible. Preserve writeback metadata from /api/ingest or the local import path, including surface/model/provider when supplied. Sensitive lanes default to candidate/staged handling, not pinned/canon.
acceptance: Session summary is stored separately from spark candidates
Spark candidates include why_keep, lane, confidence, sensitivity, and worth reason in persisted metadata or summary
Raw transcript is not saved by default
Sensitive lanes do not auto-promote to pinned or canon
Tests cover metadata preservation and candidate ingest

tickets.title: V3.9.12 Portable Terminal: local CLI/script workflow
tickets.description: Add a simple local workflow for manual use: export Crowley packet, paste it into ChatGPT or another AI/model surface, paste or point the resulting writeback into an import command/script, and print saved candidate results. Keep it boring and scriptable; no UI required in this release.
acceptance: User can export a portable Crowley packet from the local project
User can import terminal writeback from a local file or stdin
Import output reports saved session receipt, saved sparks, rejected sparks, and skipped do_not_save items
Workflow failures are clear and non-destructive
Tests or fixture command cover happy path import
